source_note: Aggregated from different Internet sources. Summaries are written in our own words; follow the links for the full stories.

trends.title: Software-defined vehicles are pulling engineering work into India
trends.summary: Global suppliers keep adding Indian engineering capacity for software-defined mobility, cybersecurity and virtual validation. Bengaluru and Pune are where most of it is happening.

items.title: thyssenkrupp Automotive Technology opens Pune engineering centre, plans 300-plus workforce
items.summary: The new capability centre already has more than 120 engineers on software-defined mobility, cybersecurity and advanced chassis work, and plans to pass 300.

items.title: SDVs, AI and virtual engineering emerge as key drivers of India's automotive engineering shift
items.summary: Industry speakers describe vehicles that are updated over the air and validated virtually, and what that changes in engineering teams.

items.title: AutoEV Bharat 2026, Bengaluru: A Must-Visit Show for Automotive OEMs
items.summary: A Bengaluru exhibition covering automotive semiconductors, sensors, batteries and smart manufacturing for OEMs.

items.title: Auto manufacturing needs greater R&D investment to tap next growth phase: CII chairman
items.summary: CII argues that electronics, software and AI are converging with mechanical engineering, so Indian suppliers need to spend more on R&D.

trends.title: Power electronics and electrified powertrains
trends.summary: Better high-voltage DC/DC conversion, hybrids built for several powertrain options, and Formula E as a test bed for inverter and motor technology.

items.title: Flex Wins 2026 Automotive News PACE Award for Fully Symmetric HV DC/DC Architecture
items.summary: The award-winning DC/DC design aims to simplify the vehicle's electrical architecture and reduce dependence on the auxiliary low-voltage network.

items.title: Mahindra Racing strengthens GEN4 technical programme with Valeo as Official Performance and Engineering Partner
items.summary: Valeo brings its electrification know-how to Mahindra's Formula E GEN4 programme.

items.title: Toyota Develops New Hybrid for Future Multi-Pathway Vehicle Platforms
items.summary: Toyota's next hybrid system is designed for platforms that keep several powertrain options open at once.

items.title: Growth of the Automotive Power Electronics Market Driven by EVs
items.summary: A market report linking growth in automotive power electronics to EV adoption. It is promotional, so read the figures with caution.

trends.title: ECUs, cameras and the electronics supply chain
trends.summary: Camera modules, engine control modules and cockpit electronics are changing hands. Capital needs are pushing smaller players out.

items.title: Foxconn acquires automotive camera module business from Sony Semiconductor Solutions
items.summary: Foxconn (Hon Hai) is buying Sony's automotive camera module business to grow in ADAS sensing. The initial deal is valued at about ¥7.2 billion (~$45 million).

items.title: BorgWarner Secures Engine Control Module Business With Major Global OEM
items.summary: BorgWarner PowerDrive Systems has won an engine control module programme with a large global OEM. Combustion and hybrid ECUs are still a live business.

items.title: Large capital needs, technology shift behind Pricol Autotech exit, says Vikram Mohan
items.summary: Pricol's promoter family is selling its entire stake, saying the automotive electronics business now needs more capital to stay competitive.

items.title: Marelli secures two honours at 2026 PACE Awards
items.summary: Marelli won recognition for next-generation display technology and vehicle connectivity.

items.title: FORVIA receives three 2026 Automotive News PACE pilot recognitions
items.summary: FORVIA was recognised for work on high-performance lighting and automotive electronics.

items.title: Japan Eyes Sri Lanka For Automotive Electronics Manufacturing
items.summary: Japanese firms are looking at Sri Lanka as a production base, citing Lanka Harness's export record and spare capacity.

trends.title: Shared platforms and standardisation
trends.summary: To cut cost and development time, carmakers are sharing platforms and agreeing on common parts.

items.title: Toyota, Nissan, Honda back Japan plan to standardize parts, lower costs
items.summary: Japan's carmakers association (JAMA) proposes industry-wide parts standards. No timeline has been given yet.

items.title: Tata Group draws Honda and Hyundai interest in vehicle and tech sharing
items.summary: Honda and Hyundai are reported to be exploring platform and technology sharing with Tata.

items.title: 2027 Hyundai ELANTRA and 2028 ELANTRA Hybrid Revealed at Los Angeles Auto Show
items.summary: The eighth-generation Elantra adds more connectivity and driver-assistance features.
